alternatives.description: Keep the canonical sweep blocked because no deterministic SectionUnit/v1 denominator exists.
alternatives.projected_effect: The sweep remains unable to assert exact Tier A/B/C counts or create per-unit process bindings.
alternatives.risk: Canonical review coverage stays unmeasurable and completion labels remain invalid.

alternatives.description: Implement deterministic anchor-occurrence SectionUnit enumeration over all five immutable source files, exact tiering, reference-target hashes, and SECTION_UNIT_REVIEW routing through ProcessFactory.
alternatives.projected_effect: The sweep obtains an exact denominator and engine-bound per-unit route receipts without changing canonical source semantics.
alternatives.risk: A defective boundary classifier could mis-segment the source, so source hashes, contiguous line coverage, conservative tiering, deterministic tests, and fail-closed ambiguity checks are required.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot produce the exact mechanically bound SectionUnit denominator required by the admitted process.
The implementation adds a parser/classifier that must remain conservative and synchronized with immutable source and ProcessVersion semantics.

assumptions: GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 is HUMAN-admitted and its SectionUnit semantics inherit the v1.0 candidate definition.
Garden v15.5 five-file canonical source is immutable and SOURCE_MANIFEST.json is the exact source identity.
This change implements existing admitted review-process semantics and does not alter Garden source semantics.
Conservative over-classification to TIER_A is preferable to silently under-reviewing normative/high-impact material.
ProcessFactory/GardenProcess owns route/state transitions; the enumerator may only create SECTION_UNIT_REVIEW instances and advance them through valid engine transitions.
reason.uncertainty: Anchor declaration conventions may contain unusual historical forms; the implementation therefore requires contiguous full-file coverage, occurrence-qualified repeated anchors, exact source hashes, and leaves unresolved references explicit rather than guessing.
counterexamples: A source byte/hash mismatch must reject inventory construction.
A line-range gap or overlap must reject the denominator.
A normative/high-impact unit classified TIER_B or TIER_C would be unsafe.
An unresolved reference must remain explicit and may later make packet closure incomplete.
A SectionUnit review process instance may not bypass ProcessFactory or mint authority from Process Algebra validation.
reason.conclusion: Implement the deterministic SectionUnit/v1 inventory as bounded process infrastructure, emit exact denominator/count artifacts, and route each unit only to ROUTED through the admitted GardenProcess engine pending packet/review work.

obligations.statement: All five canonical files are hash/byte verified against SOURCE_MANIFEST before enumeration.
Every source line belongs to exactly one contiguous SectionUnit range and the denominator exactly partitions Tier A/B/C.
Every enumerated unit can instantiate SECTION_UNIT_REVIEW and advance CREATED->ROUTED only through ProcessFactory/GardenProcess with registered Process Algebra validation.
The inventory/count/routing artifacts grant no authority and assert no sweep completion while all units remain UNREVIEWED.

items.claim_scope: The previous sweep could verify source identity but could not produce a valid SectionUnit denominator because no complete enumerator existed.
WP-002 requires source parser/extractor coverage, source anchors/hashes, gaps and tests without false coverage claims.
Defines SectionUnit/v1 and Tier A/B/C semantics incorporated into the admitted process lineage.
